description: This file defines the CustomerOptionValue entity class for managing customer option values, including descriptions, image data, and association with MerchantStore in a Java/Hibernate persistence context.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValue
classes.description: Entity class representing a customer option value with properties like code, image, descriptions, and association with MerchantStore.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this customer option value.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of this customer option value.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of descriptions for this customer option value.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the descriptions set for this customer option value.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a MerchantStore with this customer option value.

methods.name: getDescriptionsSettoList
methods.description: Converts descriptions set to list, initializing if needed.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image file associated with the customer option value.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Gets the image file associated with the customer option value.

methods.name: getCustomerOptionValueImage
methods.description: Returns the image path or filename.

methods.name: setCustomerOptionValueImage
methods.description: Sets the image path or filename.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code for the customer option value.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code for the customer option value.
